Name: Grogu Visits Yoda
Author: CopperSun
Description:
Too late for May the 4th but well within This Is The May, it's the latest mod you didn't know you needed!

If you have both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8592]Mandalorian and Baby Yoda NPCs[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8412]Altar of Yoba Redux[/url] installed, this mod allows Grogu (and Mando) to visit the altar Thursday evenings or, if married, Friday afternoons.

That's it, that's the mod.
